style.styleTitle: The White Company Set of 4 Christmas Small Glitter Baubles
style.toneOfVoice: Sparkling, festive ornament. Handmade from mouth-blown glass. Glitter finish for subtle shimmer. Matching larger bauble available. Designed to bring soft sparkle to festive settings, these mouth-blown glass baubles are finished with delicate glitter that catches and reflects the light beautifully among the branches. Hung from velvet ribbons and complete with integrated glass hooks, they add gentle shimmer to your tree and look especially elegant styled together or layered into festive tablescapes alongside the matching larger-sized baubles.
